response.justification: The candidate is a talented, versatile software craftsman but has no meaningful C++ experience (only a brief 6-month stint on C/C++ components in 2014-2015), no Windows platform development background, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. His career has been focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) which does not align with the core mandatory requirements of this role.
strengths: Highly experienced, versatile senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years in software
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) valuable in any engineering context
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months, over a decade ago) far short of the 5-10 years required
No Windows platform development experience apparent anywhere in work history
No SQL Server/Oracle or fixed income/capital markets/investment banking domain experience

key_factors.factor: No fixed income/capital markets domain exposure
No Windows or SQL Server/Oracle experience
